title: Choose a new visual world
question: Bolder hand — foreign forms only. First-dealt Flash-Scrawl Club Sleeve leads: ads live on a defaced sleeve, not a dashboard. Darkroom and Sneaker beat it on both axes; Specimen holds as a tool. Leather studio and alphabet storm sit demoted. Last hand (EDL, contact sheet, centre-rail, racing, drum, ASCII, Miura, tensegrity) is out.

options.label: Flash-Scrawl Club Sleeve
options.lineage: a french house label sleeve: direct-flash party photo, fat marker logo, fluorescent sticker on one corner
options.thesis: Each scrape is a defaced sleeve: the photo is the lot, the marker is the action, the pressed-type foot is the holdings.
options.viewport: A crushed-flash sleeve: paste URLs on the photo, Run as one pink stroke, lots as corner stickers; the table is the release strip at the foot; click redraws the selected take heavier.
options.risk: Party chrome can bury the copy if the marker outruns the credits.

raised.raise: The selected take sits proud of the sleeve; scrape progress fills as one stroke, not a status sentence.
Run is one mark laid at speed; body copy stays readable while the sleeve redraws.

options.label: Darkroom Safelight Bay
options.lineage: an amber darkroom: enlarger, timed baths, drying line, the print emerging in the tray
options.thesis: Paste, scrape, and classify are stations under safelight; ads develop in the tray instead of arriving as rows.
options.viewport: Amber bay: URL lots as enlarger notes, Run as the timer, holdings emerging in the tray; the drawer is a lifted wet print.
options.case: Beats the sleeve on both axes — strategists already watch creative appear, and the stations are the product.
options.risk: Contact-sheet déjà vu if the tray becomes a grid of frames.

options.label: Sneaker Archive Wall
options.lineage: stacked cardboard boxes, silhouette end art, colorway names as verse, tissue in the lid
options.thesis: Each ad is a box on the wall: end label for scan, half-pull to select, lid for the drawer.
options.viewport: A box wall: URL lots as stacks, holdings as end labels (page / hook / size-run); click slides a box out; the drawer is the open lid.
options.case: Beats the sleeve on both axes — DTC archives are home, and labeled ends scan fifty ads.
options.risk: The wall wants cards; the spec wants a table. End labels must stay the log.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.lineage: an interactive type specimen: one giant letter, axis sliders, a live glyph grid
options.thesis: Filters are axes; the table is the glyph grid; the selected hook is the giant letter.
options.viewport: Paper field: paste as the measure, filter sliders as axes, holdings as the glyph grid; the selected hook floods the display size.
options.case: Holds product clarity — sliders and a cell grid are the job — but a foundry specimen is not the strategist’s desk.
options.risk: The giant letter can outrank the fifty rows.

options.label: Skeuomorph Leather Studio
options.lineage: stitched-leather reading shelf, tooled headers, linen, torn paper, walnut
options.thesis: Lots as leather objects on a shelf; ads as torn pages; the drawer is a page curl.
options.viewport: A lamplit shelf: URL lots as tooled headers; holdings as paper on wood; click curls a page.
options.case: Loses both axes: strategists do not live in iOS-6 leather, and a shelf hides a 50-row scan.
options.kept: The selected take sits proud; progress fills as one stroke.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.lineage: letters condense into words, break into weather, and carve the landscape
options.thesis: Search and filters type weather; ads gather as letter fronts on white ground.
options.viewport: An open field: paste as a forming word; holdings as weather fronts; the selected id is the only solid glyph.
options.case: Loses both axes: surreal weather is not this desk, and body copy cannot be rain.
options.kept: Run is one mark at speed; row text stays readable through the redraw.
options.risk: The weather would replace the table.

canonCard.label: Play it straight
canonCard.thesis: The category standard aimed at Foreplay, Motion, and Meta’s Ad Library: left query, center table, right drawer, at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Top bar, URL input, filter row, results table, slide-over — what those products already trained.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from Foreplay / Motion by design.
